name: 06-hands-gesture
prompt: Close-up of an executive's hands gesturing mid-explanation above a dinner table, a gold cufflink catching the light, glasses and candles softly blurred behind. Cinematic, luxury, high-end corporate film. Deep black and charcoal palette, with subtle hot pink (#FF1FA9) and warm gold-yellow (#FCD500) neon rim light and soft neon glow rings. Shallow depth of field, anamorphic lens flares, rich shadows, filmic grain. No on-screen text, no logos, no watermarks.
